name: car-image
description: Studio-quality, transparent-background vehicle images for any project. Render any make, model and year in 8 camera views and any paint color, mint signed URLs a browser can load without a key, fetch catalog make logos, decode VINs for free, or build a 3D model of any vehicle.

api_key.title: Car Image API key (optional)
api_key.description: Leave empty to sign in with your browser (/mcp). Or paste a cimg_… key from https://carimage.dev/dashboard?ref=plugin for a machine without a browser: Claude Code keeps it in your system's secure credential store and sends it only to the Car Image MCP server, in the X-Api-Key header.
